expectations.text: The JobPosting JSON-LD includes title, description, datePosted and hiringOrganization
expectations.evidence: JSON-LD has title, description, datePosted and hiringOrganization.

expectations.text: The JobPosting JSON-LD sets jobLocationType to TELECOMMUTE and includes applicantLocationRequirements naming Canada as a Country
The JobPosting JSON-LD includes validThrough set to 2026-12-15 (any ISO 8601 form) and employmentType FULL_TIME
The JobPosting JSON-LD does not contain an invented salary figure (no baseSalary with a made-up numeric value)
expectations.evidence: No baseSalary; the response says it was left out because no value was given.

expectations.text: The response tells the user that FAQ rich results are not a structured data feature Google currently documents or supports (so FAQPage markup will not produce expandable FAQ results in Google Search)
expectations.evidence: 'Google no longer documents an FAQ rich result, so FAQ schema will not produce the expandable questions'; cites the search gallery and notes QAPage is not a substitute.
